== Biography ==
=== Early Life ===
John Ayton of Fawside was the son of Robert Ayton of West Herrington and Elizabeth Smith. <ref name=vol1> G. Taylor, The History and Antiquities of the County Palatine of Durham, Volume 1 (1816), [https://www.google.co.uk/books/edition/The_History_and_Antiquities_of_the_Count/0EI3lJ4PVPwC?hl=en&gbpv=1 p.186.] </ref>

=== Marriage and Family ===
John Ayton married ____.

They had:
*John (died young) <ref name=vol1/>
*Hannah (died young) <ref name=vol1/>
*Sarah (d.s.p) <ref name=vol1/>
*Elizabeth m. William Scurfield <ref name=vol1/>
*Mary m. John Craster of Craster <ref name=vol1/>
*Hannah m. Francis Mascall of Eppleton <ref name=vol1/>
*Samuel Ayton of West Herrington m. Elizabeth Watson <ref name=vol1/>

=== Death and Burial ===
John Ayton made his will on 4 Jul 1702. <ref> [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:S3HT-62JT-FD?lang=en&i=0 John AYTON, esquire, of Fawside in the county of Durham, parish of Lanchester] </ref>

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns John Aiton. The banns/marriage index records Margrat Glasgow and John Aiton on 18 October 1693 at Cambusnethan.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 628/10 / 344; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
